name: Labyrinth
author: Erin Carter
description: A full-frame orthogonal labyrinth of faintly glowing etched walls on a near-black plan. Wall segments slide along their grid axes on staggered eased schedules, perpetually rewiring the maze's topology, with soft glints blooming as walls dock into junctions.

params.label: Shift speed
params.effect: Rate of the wall reconfiguration — from a wall sliding somewhere every few seconds to the whole plan in constant gentle churn.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Maze cell size in CSS px — small gives a dense intricate plan with many sliding walls, large gives a few bold corridors.

params.label: Line width
params.effect: Stroke width of the wall lines in CSS px — thicker reads as heavy masonry, thinner as a fine engraved blueprint.

params.label: Glint
params.effect: Brightness of the brief glint when a sliding wall docks into a junction — 0 lets walls move silently, 1 punctuates every dock with a visible bloom.
